author: architecture-risk-researcher
scope: Identify architecture boundaries, failure risks, privacy constraints, and cheapest valid evidence.

local_inputs.evidence: The requested system is local and dependency-light, with no authorized external effects.
The core requires hazard-first evidence and honest UNPROVED/BLOCKED boundaries.

findings: A pure indexing boundary plus a thin command adapter keeps behavior independently testable.
Accidental file overwrite and unintended data egress are the primary privacy and recovery hazards.
recommendations: Keep all inputs and outputs local and require explicit output paths with fail-closed conflict handling.
Prove pure behavior before adding filesystem integration.
